prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A simple flame — three symmetric tongues, flat ember-orange fill
inside a flat dark outer silhouette. Two-color flat app-icon glyph.
formatted_prompt: Flat bold app icon centered on off-white (#E7E3D5) canvas with generous padding. A single flame glyph rendered in modern UI icon register — three symmetric upward tongues forming one clean silhouette, outer shape filled with deep near-black (#0B0F14), inner flame filled with vivid ember-orange (#D97742). All edges crisp vector geometry, sharp and deliberate. Two-color flat glyph, no gradients, no texture, no brushwork, no interior linework. Silhouette readable at 16px, bold and unambiguous. Centered composition, nothing else in frame.
